A completion-basis cell without measure.end is a plan_error in lr-eval; full_occupancy errors if occupancy never reaches load.value (e.g. lanes >= plays) or if the warm-up outlasts full occupancy.

Completion windows are half-open [start, end); completion-basis goodput_rps_window is good completions per second at full occupancy (attainment x throughput). Stratify gates and tables by load mode (LR-09).
Cells are lr-cells-v3 (SPLIT_MANIFEST c42dacea...); HARNESS_VERSION lrh-3, so every earlier cache entry is unreachable.
